businessArea.name: Account Review
businessArea.description: Glossary for the account review use case: customer status, revenue and stock terms whose meaning differs from what the API field names suggest.

terms.name: Account Open Flag
terms.description: True when the customer account is open for ordering (not closed or blocked). It does NOT mean the customer is an Active Customer: an open account can have bought nothing for months. Use Last Invoice Date to decide whether a customer is active.
terms.businessLogic: Active Customer = Last Invoice Date within 90 days of the reporting as-of date. is_active only says the account is open.
examples: true: account open, may or may not be an Active Customer

terms.name: Last Invoice Date
terms.description: Date of the customer's most recent invoiced order. This is the date that decides whether a customer is an Active Customer (invoiced within the last 90 days of the as-of date).
terms.businessLogic: days_since_invoice = as_of_date - last_invoice_date; Active Customer when days_since_invoice <= 90, otherwise Lapsed.

terms.name: Loyalty Tier Rank
terms.description: Rank of the customer's loyalty tier, where 1 is the HIGHEST tier: 1 = Platinum, 2 = Gold, 3 = Silver, 4 = Bronze. A lower number is a better customer; it is a rank, not a score.
terms.businessLogic: Lower is better. Never average or compare it as a score.

terms.name: Credit Limit
terms.description: Maximum open receivables allowed for the account, in CHF. Internal credit risk data.

terms.name: Reporting As-Of Date
terms.description: The date the figures in this response were computed for. Use it, not today's date, for any day count.

terms.name: Order Booking Date
terms.description: Date the order was booked (entered). It is not the invoice date and does not by itself make the order revenue.

terms.name: Order Status
terms.description: Lifecycle status of a sales order. Only orders with status invoiced count as revenue; pending orders are open (not yet revenue) and cancelled orders are never revenue.
terms.formatDescription: Text, one of pending | invoiced | cancelled

terms.name: Gross Order Value
terms.description: Order value in MINOR currency units (Rappen: 100 = CHF 1.00), INCLUDING 8.1 % Swiss VAT. It is not net revenue: Net Revenue = sum of order_total over invoiced orders / 100 / 1.081.

terms.name: Physical Stock On Hand
terms.description: Units physically in the warehouse, INCLUDING units already committed to other orders and units on quality hold. It is not what can be promised to a customer: Available To Promise = qty_available - qty_committed - qty_blocked.
examples: 45 on hand - 20 committed - 10 on hold = 15 available to promise

terms.name: Committed Quantity
terms.description: Units on hand already allocated to other confirmed orders. Not available for a new or pending order.

terms.name: Quality Hold Quantity
terms.description: Units on hand blocked by quality control (inspection, damage, recall). They cannot be shipped.

terms.name: Active Customer
terms.description: A customer with at least one invoiced order in the 90 days before the reporting as-of date. Derived from Last Invoice Date, never from Account Open Flag.
terms.businessLogic: Last Invoice Date within 90 days of the as-of date.

terms.name: Net Revenue
terms.description: Invoiced sales in CHF, excluding VAT, excluding pending and cancelled orders.

terms.name: Available To Promise
terms.description: Units that can be promised to a customer now: on hand minus committed minus quality hold.
